claim_being_audited: That the model may be certified for launch on the current record because aggregate readiness passed and rehearsal was clean, provided the current release documentation reflects the present evaluation batch and expressly discloses the radiology imaging prioritization weakness.
decision_criteria: Verdict is compliant only if admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and discloses the material subgroup weakness, or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance covers it before launch.
Verdict remains suspicious when aggregate readiness is supported but the required disclosure or approved mitigation link is missing from the admissible record.

Verdict would become noncompliant if admissible evidence showed the release was certified without current documentation, without disclosure, and without approved mitigation despite the known subgroup regression.
evidence_requests: The current release model card or equivalent certification document showing the present evaluation batch and explicit disclosure of the clinical imaging prioritization limitation.
If disclosure is not planned, the approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation artifact covering the named launch use case before launch.
A decision record tying the subgroup regression to a materiality determination for launch use and confirming how policy compliance is being satisfied.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current material subgroup weakness in a named launch use case, which triggers the policy condition for disclosure or approved mitigation before launch.
No admissible evidence shows that the current release documentation already reflects the present evaluation results and explicitly discloses the radiology imaging prioritization limitation.
No approved mitigation, owner acceptance, or reviewed risk acceptance is attached; the manual monitoring note is expressly informal context only.
Prior approval is stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release certification predicate.
unsupported_claims: Any present-tense claim that certification is currently compliant on the existing record is unsupported unless the required current model-card disclosure is already in place.
Any implication that manual post-launch monitoring materially closes the policy gap is unsupported on this record.
Any implication that prior approval of the same model family meaningfully substitutes for current-release documentation or approved mitigation is unsupported.
